## What does instant coffee jar mean for an Indian kitchen?

Choosing the right kitchen companion can transform your daily morning ritual. When you look across a crowded shelf, selecting the proper instant coffee jar comes down to understanding your palate and how you like your brew. If your mornings call for a rich, bold black cup with a strong honest kick, the 50g Bold Pure Coffee at ₹239 or the 100g jar at ₹369 delivers pure coffee with zero chicory through an agglomerated process. For those who appreciate gourmet freeze-dried granules, Purista Gourmet Robusta offers bold strength starting at ₹319, while Purica Gourmet Arabica brings smooth, natural chocolatey notes starting at ₹329. If you prefer a familiar, everyday milk coffee with a smoother profile, Ultra Blend combines 70% coffee and 30% chicory at ₹209 for 50g, giving you about 66 cups from a 100g jar at ₹309. Families or tasting enthusiasts often grab the Variety Box with four 50g jars for ₹877 to explore them all. By matching your flavor preference directly to the right Purity Beans selection, every single cup hits the exact spot you need.

### A plain definition

Whatever brought you here, the label settles it. Ultra Blend is 70% coffee and 30% chicory. The other single jars on this page are 0% chicory.

## How do you read the chicory line on the jar?

When you pick up an instant coffee jar from your kitchen cabinet, turn it around and look straight at the ingredient list before anything else. The label will tell you the exact truth of what is sitting inside the glass. If you prefer a traditional milk coffee with a smoother profile, our Ultra Blend balances 70% coffee with 30% chicory, starting at ₹209 for the 50g jar, making it roughly ₹5 a cup for over 66 cups. On the other hand, if you want pure coffee with zero chicory, you can reach for Bold at ₹239 for 50g, or explore our freeze-dried gourmet selections like Purista Robusta granules starting at ₹319 and Purica Arabica granules starting at ₹329. If you want to taste different profiles side by side without guessing, the Variety Box brings together four 50g jars for ₹877.
